case_contracts.tabs: Each Ctrl-Shift digit begins on another real daemon tab. The result must match workspace position, advance daemon revision, and preserve tab order and scene identities.
case_contracts.terminal_keys: Each bare F6/Shift-F6/F11/Ctrl-PageUp/Down case owns a fresh raw-input pane program. READY follows program execution. Correlated DONE and exact expected bytes must arrive with unchanged focused terminal, window identities, and fullscreen state.
case_contracts.polish: Native Right-Alt-L and Shift-Right-Alt-N produce exact łŃ in the production theme search.

limitations: Parent receipts retain every case completion. The bounded GUI tail retains detailed tab-5 through tab-9 and pane-byte results; early detailed tab receipts are omitted.
